visual_synopsis: An elderly couple - an old woman in round glasses and a knitted top (clearly a male actor in old-lady wig and makeup) and a mustachioed old man in striped pyjamas holding a cane - sit propped up in bed in a yellow wallpapered room watching TV, with repeated cutaways to the screen showing a football match, a music video and a blue title card. In the last minute the old man lies alone in a darker floral-wallpapered bedroom and a horned devil in a black cape with red-lit hands spreads his arms over him, apparently a dream or visitation, and the old man reacts from his pillow.
